photos.alt: A grey-haired older woman in a soft grey cardigan and floral top laughs warmly, looking off to the right, against a softly blurred communal hall.
photos.colors: soft grey, warm skin tone, muted taupe
photos.notes: 3:2 landscape. Subject is centred-left and fills the middle; the right third is a blurred hall with a dark doorway and a table, so set the headline on a cream or translucent panel rather than straight on the photo. For a tall mobile crop keep object-position near 46% so her face stays in frame. Genuine laugh, the emotional anchor of the page. Slightly cool and soft, so warm it with a gentle cream or sepia overlay to sit with the palette.

photos.alt: A small pink tiered birthday cake with piped frosting, rainbow sprinkles and tall unlit candles in blue, green, orange, purple and magenta, on a wooden board against a green striped wall.
photos.colors: rose pink, cream, bright candle accents
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. The candles are not lit. They start about a fifth of the way down, so use a tall frame or object-position 50% 30% when cropping to a square. The pink and sprinkles suit coquette/pastel/valentine palettes; use it beside the RSVP or the menu.

photos.alt: A full bouquet of pink carnations, white freesia and baby's breath in a ribbed glass vase on a weathered green painted table with old book pages, beside a sheer curtain.
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Bouquet sits centre-top; the table below is a distressed teal-green with loose book pages, which feels vintage. Crop to a square around the blooms (object-position 50% 38%). Good for a decor / table-setting card or a sticker-style cutout.

photos.alt: An elderly woman with white hair and glasses hugs and is kissed on the cheek by a young child, both lit by a warm golden glow against a dark background.
photos.colors: warm amber, deep black, soft white hair
photos.notes: Landscape. A tender, warm-lit moment on a near-black background; the young child is shown in profile, eyes closed, kissing the grandmother's cheek. Dark surround takes a light-coloured caption well. Works as a full-bleed band or a large rounded card; pair with the gift note or the memory wall. Slightly grainy in the shadows, so avoid enlarging past about 1400px.

photos.alt: Overhead view of a round white table set with dark gold-rimmed floral china, tea cups, small plated cakes and a vase of purple lilac while hands pour and pass tea.
photos.colors: cream white, gold, lilac, tea amber
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2, looks down onto the table so any crop works. Only hands are shown, no faces. Matches the cream paper and faded gold of the page; use for the menu or the arrival-and-tea section. A few confetti pieces on the floor at the top right give it a party feel.

photos.alt: Three generations of a family sit smiling at one long wooden table laden with bowls of salad and fruit, in a warm kitchen-dining room.
photos.colors: warm wood brown, brick red, cream
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Faces run along the upper half and the table fills the lower third; crop to 16:9 from the top. Shows grandparents plus children, so it works for the "who is coming" or the menu section.

photos.alt: Two hands lift old snapshots out of an open vintage photo album: a black-and-white portrait of a baby and a faded colour photo of a toddler.
photos.colors: sepia brown, warm black and white, skin tones
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Warm, nostalgic and intimate; ideal next to the 1946 to 2026 timeline or the memory-wall form. Apply a slight sepia if the page palette is sepia-leaning.

photos.alt: An older woman's hands knit a grey ribbed piece in natural window light, her floral blouse with ruffled cuffs beside a ball of grey yarn on a cream cloth.
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. Light and airy, and the floral sleeve echoes the vintage palette. Works as a tall side image beside the "she taught us" story or the recipe-card gift note.

photos.alt: A serene elderly woman with white hair, a blue-grey wool coat and a patterned scarf smiles gently at the camera against golden autumn bokeh.
photos.colors: autumn amber, slate blue, white hair
photos.notes: Second hero candidate. Landscape ~3:2; warm autumn film look suits the vintage mood. The subject is centred, so text needs a panel, and a blurred passer-by at the right edge is the only distraction. Quieter and more formal than the main hero.

photos.alt: Open vintage photo albums and loose black-and-white family portraits scattered across a table.
photos.notes: Texture / detail shot. Landscape 3:2, busy, so best behind a translucent panel or as a small framed polaroid in the timeline strip.

photos.alt: In a dark, near-monochrome sepia photograph a baby's tiny hand rests on an older woman's wrinkled, ringed hand.
photos.notes: Atmosphere / detail shot. Landscape 3:2, faces not shown, very tender; a good divider band between the timeline and the memory wall, or the closing "love" section.
